"fine_trace":[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/ox/ox.c","function":"to_gen","line":715,"var":"len","code":"len = RSTRING_LEN(ruby_xml) + 1;","note":"The attacker-controlled XML string length determines the stack allocation size used for the parser copy.","role":"source"},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/ox/ox.c","function":"to_gen","line":720,"var":"xml","code":"xml = ALLOCA_N(char, len);","note":"For small XML, the parser copy is allocated as a dynamic stack buffer exactly large enough for the bytes and terminating NUL.","role":"intermediate"},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/ox/ox.c","function":"to_gen","line":722,"var":"xml","code":"memcpy(xml, x, len);","note":"The unterminated element text is copied into the stack buffer with one trailing NUL byte at xml[len - 1].","role":"intermediate"},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/ox/ox.c","function":"to_gen","line":723,"var":"xml","code":"obj = ox_parse(xml, len - 1, ox_gen_callbacks, 0, &options, &err);","note":"Parsing begins on the attacker-controlled stack buffer and the parser records pi.str as this xml pointer.","role":"intermediate"},
{"step":5,"file":"ext/ox/parse.c","function":"read_element","line":701,"var":"pi->s","code":"read_text(pi);","note":"After parsing a start tag with non-whitespace text, read_element calls read_text with pi->s pointing at attacker-controlled text content.","role":"intermediate"},
{"step":6,"file":"ext/ox/parse.c","function":"read_text","line":731,"var":"pi->s","code":"c = *pi->s++;","note":"The text loop consumes bytes until it reads the terminating NUL and post-increments pi->s to one byte past the stack buffer object.","role":"intermediate"},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/ox/parse.c","function":"read_text","line":737,"var":"pi->s","code":"case '\\0': set_error(&pi->err, \"invalid format, document not terminated\", pi->str, pi->s); return;","note":"The error path passes the post-incremented pointer as current; the safety condition should keep current within the copied XML object instead of one byte past it.","role":"root_cause"},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/ox/err.c","function":"_ox_err_set_with_location","line":37,"var":"*current","code":"for (; xml < current && '\\n' != *current; current--) {","note":"The location formatter dereferences current before moving it backward, so the one-past-end pointer causes an out-of-bounds stack read.","role":"sink"}
],
"vuln_logic":{
"source":{"file":"ext/ox/ox.c","function":"to_gen","line":715,"operands":["RSTRING_LEN(ruby_xml)","len"]},
"root_cause":{"file":"ext/ox/parse.c","function":"read_text","line":737,"operands":["pi->s"],"relation":{"op":"le","left":"pi->s","right":"pi->end"}},
"sink":{"file":"ext/ox/err.c","function":"_ox_err_set_with_location","line":37,"operands":["*current","current"],"relation":{"op":"lt","left":"current","right":"xml"}},
"propagation":[]}}
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,separators=(',',':')))
PY
printf '<a>a' > /workspace/poc.xml
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.xml /workspace/analysis.json
